summary: Grouping by function lets a play target only one kind of host, for example adding an iptables rule only on dbservers.
questions: How do I apply firewall rules only to database servers?

answer_card.title: Group hosts by function
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: dbservers
  tasks:
    - name: Allow access from 10.0.0.1
      ansible.builtin.iptables:
        chain: INPUT
        jump: ACCEPT
        source: 10.0.0.1
```
